Module com.example.masroofy_app
Package com.example.masroofy_app.model

Class DatabaseHelper

java.lang.Object
com.example.masroofy_app.model.DatabaseHelper
public class DatabaseHelper extends Object
Singleton class responsible for all database operations in the application. It manages a single shared database connection and initializes the database on startup. It also ensures the connection is safely closed when the application shuts down using a shutdown hook.

    • savePin

      public void savePin(String pin)
      Saves a user PIN in the database. If a PIN already exists, it updates the existing record. Otherwise, it inserts a new record. The PIN is securely stored using SHA-256 hashing.
      Parameters:
      pin - the plain text PIN entered by the user

    • verifyPin

      public boolean verifyPin(String inputPin)
      Verifies whether the provided PIN matches the stored hashed PIN. The input PIN is hashed and compared with the stored value in the database.
      Parameters:
      inputPin - the PIN entered by the user
      Returns:
      true if the PIN is correct, false otherwise

    • saveCycle

      public boolean saveCycle(BudgetCycle cycle)
      Saves a budget cycle to the database. If the cycle already exists (id > 0), it updates the existing record. Otherwise, it deactivates all previous cycles and inserts a new active cycle.
      Parameters:
      cycle - the budget cycle object containing financial data
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful, false otherwise

    • getCycle

      public BudgetCycle getCycle()
      Retrieves the currently active budget cycle from the database. The method returns the most recent active cycle and reconstructs it into a BudgetCycle object.
      Returns:
      the active BudgetCycle, or null if none exists
